faq.question: Q1. Can a graduate apply for the Research Project Manager post?
faq.answer: Yes. A graduate can apply with a PG Diploma in Clinical Research or an equivalent qualification, along with three years of clinical research experience.

faq.question: Q2. Does more experience increase the pay?
faq.answer: For graduate-route candidates, yes: pay rises from Rs. 45,000/- at 3 years of experience to Rs. 55,000/- at 5 years and above. The notice prints a single figure of Rs. 55,000/- for postgraduate-route candidates.

faq.question: Q3. How long will the contract last?
faq.answer: It starts with six months. Any extension depends on performance and the institute's requirement.

faq.question: Q4. How will I know my interview date?
faq.answer: The date is sent by email to eligible candidates only, so the email ID in your application must be valid.

faq.question: Q5. What happens if I do not bring original documents to the interview?
faq.answer: You will not be allowed to appear for the interview.

faq.question: Q6. Do internal candidates need any extra document?
faq.answer: Yes. They need to submit an NOC from their current HOD, OIC or Principal Investigator.

faq.question: Q7. Will accommodation be provided for outstation candidates?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that accommodation will not be provided to outstation candidates.
